---
title: '05_regressions'
---

```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)

rm(list = ls())

options("scipen" = 100, "digits" = 4)

set.seed(20240101)

```

```{r}
results <- read.csv("outputs/estimates_55_64.csv")

data <- results %>%
  filter(projected == 0) %>%
  select(var, country, gender, cohort_two, WLE) %>%
  unique() %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = var, values_from = WLE) %>%
  rename("wle_a" = "wle_adjusted", "wyl_ret" = "wyl_retirement", "wyl_une" = "wyl_unemployment", "wyl_ina" = "wyl_inactivity")

data <- data %>%
  group_by(gender) %>%
  complete(country, cohort_two) %>%
  group_by(gender, country) %>%
  arrange(cohort_two, .by_group = T) %>%
  mutate(
    wle_lag = dplyr::lag(wle, 1),
    wle_change = wle - dplyr::lag(wle, 1),

    wle_a_lag = dplyr::lag(wle_a, 1),
    wle_a_change = wle_a - dplyr::lag(wle_a, 1),

    wyl_ret_lag = dplyr::lag(wyl_ret, 1),
    wyl_ret_change = wyl_ret - dplyr::lag(wyl_ret, 1),

    wyl_une_lag = dplyr::lag(wyl_une, 1),
    wyl_une_change = wyl_une - dplyr::lag(wyl_une, 1),

    wyl_ina_lag = dplyr::lag(wyl_ina, 1),
    wyl_ina_change = wyl_ina - dplyr::lag(wyl_ina, 1)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(wle_change))

```

```{r}
models <- c(
  "wle_a_change ~ wle_change + wle_a_lag + factor(country) + factor(cohort_two)",
  "wyl_ret_change ~ wle_change + wyl_ret_lag + factor(country) + factor(cohort_two)",
  "wyl_une_change ~ wle_change + wyl_une_lag + factor(country) + factor(cohort_two)",
  "wyl_ina_change ~ wle_change + wyl_ina_lag + factor(country) + factor(cohort_two)")

coefs <- function(df) {
  sapply(models, function(m) coef(lm(as.formula(m), data = df))["wle_change"])
}

table_1 <- NULL

for (g in c("Men", "Women")) {

data_g <- data %>% filter(gender == g)

# bootstrap: countries and observations within countries drawn with replacement
boot <- NULL

for (b in 1:1000) {

  countries <- sample(unique(data_g$country), replace = T)

  data_b <- NULL

  for (j in 1:length(countries)) {
    data_c <- data_g %>% filter(country == countries[j])
    data_c <- data_c[sample(nrow(data_c), replace = T), ]
    data_c$country <- paste0(countries[j], "_", j)
    data_b <- rbind(data_b, data_c)
  }

  boot <- rbind(boot, coefs(data_b))

}

table_g <- data.frame(
  gender = g,
  model = c("wle_a", "wyl_ret", "wyl_une", "wyl_ina"),
  coef = coefs(data_g),
  se = apply(boot, 2, sd, na.rm = T),
  n = sapply(models, function(m) nobs(lm(as.formula(m), data = data_g))))

table_1 <- rbind(table_1, table_g)

}

table_1 <- table_1 %>%
  mutate(
    p = round(2 * pnorm(-abs(coef / se)), 4),
    stars = case_when(p < 0.001 ~ "***", p < 0.01 ~ "**", p < 0.05 ~ "*", T ~ ""))

rownames(table_1) <- NULL

write.csv(table_1, "outputs/table1_regressions.csv", row.names = F)

table_1

```
